main_body: repeating dark overgrown grass/weed ground terrain patch
evidence: This is a flat ground terrain patch (4x3 tiles of overgrown dark grass and small weeds/flowers), which naturally presents a continuous horizontal top-down/3/4 ground surface filling all 48 rows with no vertical front face required.

style.evidence: The candidate ground patch uses 5 shades of muted olive-green plus small red and gold flower/seed accents and dark brown shadows, matching the Beodeul reference's pixel-cluster density, value separation, and absence of black sticker outlines.
